column1: # C28 question 4 at the `textRegionMask` seam: what it costs, in published bytes, to let the
# shape term's accepted line groups into the 1-bit stencil. 2026-08-22.
# 26 pages in two arms. `arm=subbar`: the 16 of the 73 sub-bar pages where `lineN >= 1` — the
# exact population the layering-seam wiring (`inkOut < 0.045 AND lineN == 0`) refuses, so the two
# prices are over the same pages. `arm=picture`: the ten picture pages of
# SHAPETERM-PICTURES-2026-08-21.tsv, where the term's false positives are.
# Instrument: `WIDENBYTES=1 score-shape-term <pdf> <page>`, one page per invocation, from one
# binary built at this commit. Two `Flattener.mrcLayers` calls per page differing in ONE property,
# the box list: shipped, and shipped + one synthetic box per accepted line group. Nothing in
# Sources/ was changed for it — `mrcLayers` reads `boxes` only to refuse an empty list and to
# build `textRegionMask`, so a synthetic box is exactly the word Vision would have returned.
# Bytes are stencil (jbig2) + background + foreground at the default Photo detail (Balanced).
# Control: `shipBytes` is byte-identical to SHAPETERM-BYTES-2026-08-21.tsv's `layered` column on
# 16 of 16 rows — a different tool (`score-text-route`) measuring the same thing.
# 31 of the 44 columns are score-shape-term's pre-existing ones: 806 shared cells over 26 of 26 rows
# reproduce SHAPETERM-73, -PICTURES, -RIM and -PICTURES-RIM with 0 differences (22 columns against the
# first two, the 9 rim columns against the last two, which are the only files that hold them). Only
# SHAPETERM-PICTURES-RIM is a column *prefix* of this file — the 73 and RIM files carry a different
# second column and four trailing label columns.
